tagline: Leading in heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and liquid cooling solutions for commercial and industrial indoor environments.
hero_kpi_rationale: The BASX segment, focused on data center cooling solutions, is a key growth driver, benefiting from the rapid expansion of the AI and high-performance computing market.

kpis.name: Data Center Cooling Solutions Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from customized cooling solutions for hyperscale data centers.
kpis.description: This KPI reflects the performance of the BASX brand, specialized in data center cooling solutions, a rapidly expanding market.
kpis.signal: The data center market is growing strongly due to AI.

kpis.short: Commercial and Industrial New Construction Market Growth
kpis.name: Commercial and Industrial New Construction Market Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual growth rate of the new construction market for commercial and industrial environments.
kpis.description: Indicates the dynamics of the company's primary market, which experienced approximately 50% growth between 2022 and 2024, although moderate contraction began in late 2024 and continued into 2025.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of demand for HVAC systems.

kpis.name: Data Center Construction Spending Growth
kpis.explanation: Annual growth rate of construction spending for data centers (put in place construction spending).
kpis.description: Shows the dramatic expansion of the data center market between 2022 and 2025, driving demand for BASX solutions, with current indicators suggesting continued strength and no significant signs of slowdown.
kpis.signal: Reflects massive investment in AI infrastructure.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Company's consolidated gross margin (Gross Profit / Net Sales).
kpis.description: Gross margin measures direct profitability of sales after deducting cost of goods sold. In 2025, the margin declined to 26.7% (385.7M / 1,442.1M) from 33.1% in 2024 (397.1M / 1,200.6M), a 3.0-point decrease due to tariff impacts and supply chain challenges.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue (Income from Operations / Net Sales).
kpis.description: Operating margin indicates profitability of core business activities before interest and taxes. In 2025, it stood at 10.1% (146.2M / 1,442.1M) compared to 17.4% in 2024 (209.1M / 1,200.6M), reflecting pressure on gross margin and higher SG&A expenses.

kpis.name: R&D Investment as % Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: This ratio shows the company's commitment to innovation and development of new technologies. R&D is included in cost of sales (component of Cost of Sales) and not reported separately.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's commitment to innovation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Total spending on physical assets to support growth.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reflect the company's commitment to expanding production capacity to meet rising demand. Source note 'substantial capital investments to expand our capacity' to support BASX growth.

kpis.name: Raw Material Price Changes
kpis.explanation: Percentage change in prices of key raw materials used (copper, steels, aluminum).
kpis.description: Tracking price changes in copper (+11.1%), stainless steel (-13.0%), galvanized steel (-3.4%), and aluminum (stable) compared to December 31, 2024. These raw materials directly impact manufacturing costs.

kpis.short: AI and High-Performance Compute Driven Data Center Market
kpis.name: AI and High-Performance Compute Driven Data Center Market
kpis.explanation: Impact of AI and high-performance computing on demand for data center cooling solutions.
kpis.description: The growth of AI and high-performance computing (HPC) is driving major innovation in the data center market, increasing demand for advanced cooling and liquid cooling solutions from AAON BASX. The maturation and increasing adoption of AI are causing profound shifts, with data center construction spending growing 240% between 2022 and 2025.
kpis.signal: AI is transforming the data center market.

risks.title: Dependence on Third-Party Sales Representatives
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in Item 1A and Item 7. The sales model relies entirely on a network of independent representatives for the AAON Oklahoma segment. The language emphasizes that while the strategy is valued, it involves a 'loss of complete control over the sales process'. The dependence is material to the core business.

risks.title: Economic and Construction Market Conditions Risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is clearly stated in Item 1A and elaborated in Item 7 MD&A. The core AAON Oklahoma business is highly tied to C&I new construction cycles, which are affected by external factors (interest rates, inflation, employment). The MD&A confirms: after 50% growth from 2022 to 2024, markets 'began to contract in late 2024, and the softening continued throughout 2025, albeit at a moderate pace'.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT Disruption Risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in Item 1A. IT systems are essential to operations. The language highlights potential threats ('disrupted', 'material adverse effect'). The evolving nature of cybersecurity threats suggests an increasing trend in the overall risk landscape.

risks.title: Concentration of Sales Among a Few Major Customers
risks.score_rationale: This risk is identified in Item 1A. Dependence on a limited number of customers is material, particularly for the BASX segment which serves a 'more concentrated customer base'. The language used ('material adverse effect') is significant. BASX's explosive growth (143.5% in 2025) may amplify this concentration.

risks.title: Supply Chain, Raw Material Prices, and Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is well described in Item 1A and extensively developed in Item 7 MD&A. The MD&A details concrete tariff impacts: 'Beginning in January 2025, the current United States Administration began enacting tariffs...On April 1, 2025 we instituted a 6.0% tariff surcharge on AAON-branded orders'. Material and component costs are key drivers of COGS. Gross margin declined by 7 points (33.1% to 26.7%) partly due to these factors.

risks.title: Risk of Loss of Key Employees and Recruitment Challenges
risks.score_rationale: This risk is highlighted in Item 1A and Item 7. The MD&A confirms: 'we continue to experience challenges in a tight labor market, especially the hiring of production labor'. The company had to increase wages (3.3% in 2024, 4.0% in 2025) to remain competitive. Explosive growth (backlog up 110.9% in 2025) intensifies operational capacity and talent needs.

ai_positioning.summary: Although AAON does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence (AI) in the context of its own operations or capabilities, it recognizes AI as a major market demand driver. The impact of AI is discussed solely within the context of the data center market (BASX segment), where 'the growth and adoption of AI and high-performance computing are driving profound innovation and increased demand' for customized cooling solutions.
evidence: MD&A: 'The growing maturity and adoption of Artificial Intelligence and high-performance compute is driving profound innovation across the data center market, resulting in increased demand for our products and solutions.'
MD&A: 'Between 2022 and 2025, total put in place construction spending for data centers expanded by approximately 240.0%' driven by AI infrastructure investments
BASX segment description: serves 'hyperscale data center market' for high-performance cooling solutions
